g.text: O(log n) is the time to find the starting node (the smallest key ≥ 10).

text.font-family: Nunito, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: This involves traversing from the root to a leaf, which takes logarithmic time relative to the number of keys n.

text.font-family: Nunito, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: k is the number of keys returned in the range (the number of keys between 10 and 20).

text.font-family: Nunito, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: Once the starting point is found, the algorithm performs an in-order traversal of the relevant leaf nodes to collect all k matching keys.
